answer: A salt-lagoon mapping guild used to enroll a whole night crew with one photocopied sounding card. Now a new key claims only one atlas cell per tide: it posts 33 units, draws C=H(key||tide) mod 91, and from minute (hash mod 13)+7 has 18 minutes to plant a 22 cm serialized beacon on that cell's spit. The watch camera and the beacon log must match a 6-beat flash, and the serial cannot have been lit this season. If the pattern is copied or the cell is double-booked, the 33-unit bond and the sponsor's next two tides are forfeit, so fake mappers pay in lost water time, not cheap extra cards.
